about: Known strings of the 2026-10 redesign (English text = Laravel JSON translation key). admin_spec rows = spec/admin/i18n/admin_strings_en.json (1,733 strings: settings, sections, pages, cards, theme/colour-style/look/family names, public hero wording); theme_spec rows = look badges, daily-design holiday labels and the per-theme hero/section wording of the theme mockups. old_label = the label the string replaces (its translation is the fallback). Strings added later by the work packages are found by scripts/i18n/extract.php in the source paths of sources.json. final_pass rows = labels the views translate with __($variable) whose English text lives inside controller / view code (choices built in code, the confirm verbs, the shell's status words), found by the final translation pass's runtime scan of the merged redesign.
